# Orbital Scene Assets

- Three.js 0.170.0 and OrbitControls installed from the `three` npm package.
- Library license: accompanying LICENSE (MIT), retained from the upstream package.
- Earth textures: https://threejs.org/examples/textures/planets/earth_atmos_2048.jpg,
  earth_normal_2048.jpg and earth_specular_2048.jpg in the same upstream directory.
- These textures are contextual visual basemaps, not dated project-verification imagery.
- No Apple imagery, branding or interface source was copied. Spatial-interface references informed an original GreenLens layout.
